title: feat(example-showcase): host record_header / record_more / record_related for showcase_task
body:
Fixes #22030

Clause-②: no

The showcase now hosts the three record action locations for `showcase_task` on stock pages, so `records-forms.action-location-matrix` A1 (record_header / record_more / record_related) and A3 (the url and api dispatch from the ⋯ overflow) can be run on a stock showcase boot. This is a fixture change in `examples/app-showcase` only: no product code, no checklist edit, and no new action.

## What changed

| Location | Host | Actions it shows (`showcase_task`) |
|---|---|---|
| `record_header` | Task Detail (`showcase_task_detail`): a new `page:header` node, first in the page | `showcase_mark_done` (script), `showcase_log_time` (form), `showcase_archive_task` (script), as inline buttons |
| `record_more` | the same header's ⋯ overflow | `showcase_open_docs` (url), `showcase_recalc_estimate` (api), `showcase_recalc_selection` (api) |
| `record_related` | Project Detail (`showcase_project_detail`): a new `related` tab with the Tasks `record:related_list` | `showcase_log_time` on each row (beside the `list_item` actions) |

- `src/ui/pages/task-detail.page.ts`: adds `page:header` with `actions` set to the task's six `record_header` / `record_more` action ids, which is the set the synthesized header would carry. No `title`, so the heading still comes from the record. The host's Edit / Share / Delete (order 100 to 120) still append after the authored actions.
- `src/ui/pages/project-detail.page.ts`: keeps the `tasks` tab and its `record:line_items` grid unchanged. Adds a third tab, `related`, with `record:related_list` for `showcase_task` through `project`. It has no `actions` key, so the rows carry the host bridge's actions.
- `src/ui/actions/index.ts`: comment only. The note on `showcase_reopen_task` said the Task Detail page "renders no header action bar". That is no longer true, so the comment now points to the header's id list and to the pin that holds it.
- `test/record-action-location-hosts.test.ts` (new, 9 cases) pins both hosts on the page the console picks for each object. It also holds the authored lists equal to the declarations they copy: the header ids against the task's `record_header` / `record_more` set, and the related list's `title` / `columns` against the FK's `relatedListTitle` / `relatedListColumns`.
- `test/project-detail-tabs.test.ts`: the tab strip is now `details, tasks, related` (3 items, was 2).

## Why this shape (measured at the objectui pin `a58626c88dc8`)

- **The hosts must sit on the existing pages.** `usePageAssignment` renders the FIRST `type: 'record'` page bound to an object, in declaration order, so a second page for either object would never be reached.
- **A `kind: 'full'` page renders only what it declares** (objectui#7298 ruling, `RecordDetailView`). With no `page:header` node, the page had no title bar. `PageHeaderProps.actions` is spec-declared (`z.array(z.string())`, "Action IDs to show in header"). The renderer (`containers.tsx`, `resolvedHeaderActions`) looks the ids up in the object's metadata and places each one by its `locations`: `record_header` actions go inline, and an action that declares `record_more` without `record_header` always goes under ⋯. `os validate` (`validate-action-name-refs`) checks the same ids.
- **The `tabs` slot is a full replacement**, so overriding it removed the synthesized related-list strip. `showcase_task.project` is the task's only parent relationship. `RelatedRecordActionsBridge` wraps the whole record-page body, authored or synthesized, and places `list_item` + `record_related` on the rows of any `record:related_list` under a parent record (`ROW_LOCATIONS_IN_RECORD`). For an authored node with no `actions`, the record-related-list renderer leaves those host actions untouched.
- **Alternative considered and not taken:** moving project-detail's override from `tabs` to `details`, which would keep the synthesized strip itself. It would remove the authored `page:tabs` that the #5776 pin exists for, drop the `?tab=tasks` token, and move the editable grid into the Details tab.
- **Deviation from the card's wording:** the card asks for "the synthesized Tasks related list". The list here is an authored `record:related_list` node, the same component and the same bridge as the synthesizer's output, with `title` / `columns` copied from the FK (only the synthesizer reads `relatedListTitle` / `relatedListColumns`). The follow-up knownGap lift should say "the Tasks related list".

## Guard: `record:line_items` stayed

It was not removed from project-detail. `git grep -n 'record:line_items'` over `docs/qa/platform-checklist` and `examples/app-showcase/test` at HEAD:

- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/records-forms.json:1547` and `:1661` (this item's knownGap and its revision-7 history row, both describing the gap)
- `examples/app-showcase/test/project-detail-line-items.test.ts:13, :22, :56, :89` (the #21142 column pin, still green)
- `examples/app-showcase/test/record-action-location-hosts.test.ts:20` (this PR's docblock)

## Verification (HEAD `3ae68e530c`)

- **Showcase suite:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase test` exit 0, 33 files / 408 tests.
- **The new and updated test files, verbose:** 13/13 green.
- **`validate` and `typecheck`:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase validate` exit 0 ("Validation passed"). None of its 72 warnings names either page, `showcase_task.*` or `relatedList*`. `typecheck` exit 0; `tsc --listFiles` includes both pages and both test files.
- **Ablation** (one-time, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` WRAP mode, every leg restored with blob == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`):
  - leg 1, task header retyped to `page:card`: 4 failed / 5 passed;
  - leg 2, related list retyped to `record:highlights`: 4 failed / 5 passed (re-run after hardening two cases that passed vacuously the first time, 2 failed / 7 passed);
  - leg 3, `record_header` added to `showcase_reopen_task` without adding it to the header: 1 failed, the set-equality case, naming `showcase_reopen_task`.
- **Gates:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` on the actual diff derived 42 commands. All 42 ran, each with a recorded exit code, and all exit 0. `--ran`: "42 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 42 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero)". `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first answered PREREQUISITE NOT MET (8 packages unbuilt); it was re-run after building them and answered exit 0. Named in the dispatch and green: `check:page-declaration-shape`, `check:examples-live-imports`, `check:i18n-coverage` ("none new"), `check:react-page-adapter-contract`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:org-identifier`, `check-undeclared-dep-imports` (+ `--self-test`), `check:nul-bytes`.
- **Lint, narrowed:** eslint `--no-inline-config --format json` over the 5 changed files: 5 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings. These files fall under the config block for `examples/**/*.{ts,tsx,mts,cts}`. The config never enables type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`), so this diff cannot change the verdict on any untouched file. The full `pnpm lint` run is CI's.
- **Live boot** (backend only, `pnpm dev:showcase -- --fresh` on a random port, torn down afterwards): from the served `GET /api/v1/meta/page` list and `GET /api/v1/meta/object/showcase_task`:
  - record pages are served in the order `showcase_project_detail`, then `showcase_task_detail`, each the first for its object;
  - all six header ids match a served action, and they equal the served `record_header` / `record_more` set. Three are inline-eligible (script, form, script) and three are overflow-only (url, api, api);
  - project-detail serves the tabs `details, tasks, related`, with `record:line_items` kept;
  - `record_related` on the task is `showcase_log_time`, and a seeded project has 2 tasks.
- **NOT MEASURED: the browser render of the two surfaces.** No console bundle exists in any checkout here, and building one would mean a full objectui build at the pin. The rendering claims above are read from objectui source at the pin.

## Acceptance notes

- The knownGap lift on `records-forms.action-location-matrix` is a follow-up that cites this PR, after this PR and #22029 are both on `main`. #22029 holds `records-forms.json`, and this PR does not touch it.
- `packages/spec/src/ui/component.test.ts` cites `task-detail.page.ts:40` and `:76` in comments. Both were already stale at the base (`:76` read `location: 'record_section'`), and this diff shifts them by a further 35 lines. Comment drift only: noted here, not filed. Carrier: none.
- The new tab label `Related` and list title `Tasks` have no zh-CN entry. The same is true of the existing `Details` / `Tasks` tab labels: slot content is outside the extractor's walk, and `check:i18n-coverage` reports none new.
- `showcase_task.project`'s comment ("Tasks are added later from the Project DETAIL page's Tasks related list") was untrue on `main` and is true again with this PR.

## Labels
